name: LabPanels
title: Lab panels (INVALID — violates CSD-1)
description:
Glucose (2345-7) is part of BOTH panels. FHIR's nested `concept[]` can only express a TREE, so serialising this DAG as nesting emits the code once per parent.

That breaks invariant CSD-1 — *"Within a code system definition, all the codes SHALL be unique"*. Older HAPI silently kept one copy; current HAPI rejects the resource.

Note the give-away: `count` says 5, but `concept[]` holds 6 nodes — the resource contradicts itself. The duplicate copies are byte-identical, so the nesting adds nothing; it only repeats.

See polyhierarchy-VALID-flat.json for the same content serialised correctly.
